name: SMS/MMS (Termux)
description: Unified Termux SMS/MMS channel — SMS and MMS receive/send, persisted high-water marks, media saved to workspace

allowFrom.description: Comma-separated sender allowlist. Empty = allow all.

mediaDir.description: Where to save received MMS parts. Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace/media/inbound

hookScript.description: Optional script called per received MMS part: hook <mime> <path>. Absent = file-drop only.
